_cRuleName_: The name of the rule to remove, as text; case is ignored.
aProperties: The properties, as a hash list [ :name = value, ... ].
bOnOff: 1 to turn strict mode on, 0 to turn it off.
cMetric: The metric to sort by, such as :nodesAdded, :edgesAdded or :hasCycles.
cSimContent: The text of a .stzsim simulation, as ExportToStzSim writes it.
n: The position of the node; 1 is the first.
nMode: The heuristic: 1 for Euclidean distance between the :x and :y coordinates, 2 for Manhattan.
nWeight: The new weight, as a number.
oBaseline: The baseline stzGraph that the variations are compared with.
oBaselineGraph: The baseline stzGraph that the changes are measured from.
pAnswer: The reply: a text, a list of texts, or numbers that pick the proposed options.
pFromNodeId: The id of the node the edge starts from.
pFunc: A function to call, given as an anonymous function or as a function name.
pSource: The path of a .zknw file, or the text of a knowledge file.
pToNodeId: The id of the node the edge ends at.
paConstraints: The laws to declare, as a list of text such as [ "unique", "transitive" ].
paEdges: The edges, each a hash list [ :from, :to, :label, :properties ].
paMeta: The provenance, as a hash list such as [ :source = "vet", :confidence = 0.9 ].
paOperationParams: The operation to test, as a hash list [ :from = id, :to = id, :label = text ].
paOptions: The canvas options as a hash list, such as [ :Layout = :Hierarchical, :SizeBy = :Impact ].
paPaths: A list of paths, each a list of node ids; the last id of each path names the node.
paPattern: A pattern [ subject, predicate, object ]; a subject or object starting with ? is a variable.
paToNodesIdsAndLabelsAndProps: The target nodes, each with its label and properties.
paaPatterns: A list of patterns, each [ subject, predicate, object ].
pacNames: The conversation names, as a list of text.
pacNodeIds: The node ids, as a list of text.
pacNodes: The node ids to add, as a list of text.
pacPath: A path as a list of node ids; the last id names the node.
pacToNodesIds: The ids of the nodes the edges end at, as a list of text.
paoGraphs: The graphs to compare with: [ g1, g2 ] or named, [ [ "name", g1 ], ... ].
pcConvName: The conversation name, as text; case is ignored.
pcEntity: The entity, as text; case is ignored.
pcFileName: The file name, as text; .zknw is added when missing.
pcFilename: The file name, as text; .zknw is added when missing.
pcFrom: The id of the node the edge starts from.
pcFromNodeId: The id of the node the edge starts from.
pcGoal: The id of the goal node, where the search ends.
pcKnowFile: The knowledge file to write, as text; .zknw is added when missing.
pcLaw: The law, as text: unique, symmetric or transitive.
pcNewId: The id of the new node, as text.
pcNewId1: The id of the first new node.
pcNewId2: The id of the second new node.
pcNewLabel: The label of the new node.
pcO: The object of the fact, as text.
pcObject: The object of the fact, as text.
pcP: The predicate of the fact, as text.
pcPredicate: The predicate (the relation) of the fact, as text.
pcProp: The property to test, as text; label, id and the node's own properties are accepted.
pcProperty: The property or relation to define, as text.
pcReturnType: The kind of answer wanted: :stzGraphComparison, :stzHashList or :stzListOfLists.
pcRuleGroup: The name of a registered rule group, as text.
pcS: The subject of the fact, as text.
pcSink: The id of the node the flow ends at.
pcSource: The id of the node the flow starts from.
pcStart: The id of the node the search starts from.
pcSubject: The subject of the fact, as text.
pcTag: The tag to look for among the :tags property.
pcTargetId: The id of the existing node to insert next to.
pcTo: The id of the node the edge ends at.
pcToNodeId: The id of the node the edge ends at.
pnCount: How many nodes to return; 5 when empty.
poRuleSet: The stzGraphRuleSet whose rules are attached.
